verdict.rationale: Motion has a live REST API that requires an X-API-Key header, but nothing in the evidence shows these keys can be scoped, restricted to specific resources, or issued per agent with limited permissions. The pricing page lists 'Permissions & Access Control' only as a workspace feature, with no tie to API credentials. Scoped credentials are a fair question for a SaaS product with a public API, so the absence of evidence makes this 'none'.
